'''Jerry Lobozzo''' (born in Irvington, New Jersey) is an American voice actor for the English dub of ''[[Pokémon the Series]]''.

==Biography==
Lobozzo was born in Irvington, New Jersey, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined ''Pokémon the Series'' during its [[S01|first season]]. During his first three seasons of working on the series, Lobozzo was only credited by his last name; he was credited by his full name afterwards. He last did voices for the [[S04|fourth season]] and ''[[Pokémon Chronicles]]''.
